Class Post

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.Post
public class Post extends Object

Title: Post Class

Description: This Post class represents a single student discussion post in the Student Discussion System. A post belongs to exactly one DiscussionThread, has an author identified by their username, carries the post body text, records the creation timestamp, and carries a soft-delete flag. When a student deletes their own post, isDeleted is set to TRUE in the database; the row is never physically removed. Replies attached to a deleted post remain visible, but the UI shows a notice that the original post has been removed instead of the original content.

      public Post()

      Method: Post()

      Description: Default constructor — not used directly, required by the framework.

    • Post

      public Post(int threadId, String authorUsername, String title, String content, LocalDateTime timestamp)

      Method: Post(int threadId, String authorUsername, String content, LocalDateTime timestamp)

      Description: Constructor used when creating a brand-new post before it is saved to the database. The postId field is intentionally left at 0; it is populated via setPostId() once the database auto-increment value is retrieved. isDeleted defaults to false because a newly created post is never deleted.

      Parameters:
      threadId - the thread this post is being submitted to
      authorUsername - the username of the student authoring the post
      content - the body text of the post
      timestamp - the moment the post was submitted

    • Post

      public Post(int postId, int threadId, String authorUsername, String title, String content, LocalDateTime timestamp, boolean isDeleted)

      Method: Post(int postId, int threadId, String authorUsername, String content, LocalDateTime timestamp, boolean isDeleted)

      Description: Full constructor used when loading a Post from a database ResultSet. All six fields are supplied directly from the query result.

      Parameters:
      postId - the database-generated primary key
      threadId - the thread this post belongs to
      authorUsername - the author's username
      content - the body text
      timestamp - when the post was created
      isDeleted - true if the student has soft-deleted this post
